hook.line: Want your website to actually show up on Google? Here's how to set up SEO in minutes.
hook.visual: B-roll of the creator sitting down at a blue-lit desk with a curved monitor, under a bold logo and title 'How to make your website RANK ON GOOGLE'.

beats.what: Desk b-roll with brand logo and two-line title; single white words pop up at the bottom
Cut to a three-band template: gradient top, WordPress plugin screen in the middle, green band with one-word captions
Pages list for on-page SEO; then focus keyword and meta description fields
Section title 'Connect to Google Search Console' appears in the top band
Zoom punch on the HTML-tag verification step
Sitemap URL typed into Search Console and submitted
Plugin search for Google Site Kit, then its setup screen
Mobile editor view of a site to fix spacing and text size
Ends on the mobile page with the line that this is how your site ranks

why_it_works: Opens on a person at a real desk before any screen recording, so the first frame feels like a creator, not a software tutorial
A fixed three-band template (section title, screen, one big word) keeps a fast, dense walkthrough readable: the eye always knows where to look
One large word at a time in the bottom band is readable on mute and paces the viewer at the 4.2 words/s narration
Each step is a short cut on the exact screen (median shot 2.3 s), so the video can be saved and followed click by click
weaknesses: The screen UI text is tiny (median text height 1.3% of frame); viewers cannot read the settings without pausing
Very fast narration (4.24 words/s) for a tutorial with many steps
No call to action at the end, and the face never returns after the opening b-roll
for_robert: Copy the fixed band layout for screen demos: section title on top, screen in the middle, one big word at the bottom; Fred can sit in the top band and announce each new section.
